channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Byron Scott | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Byron Scott from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: JR Smith on Byron Scott
item.description:
JR Smith:

“Anybody knows who Byron Scott as a coach, probably second to none on you're going to be in shape where they're going to make you quit. And we did this drill that lasted, first 35 minutes of practice, and it was all running. And I literally thought to myself for sure I should have went to college.”

JR Smith on Byron Scott, Jun 10, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Byron Scott, Cooper Flagg
item.description:
Thompson said.

“I feel like B-Scott sometimes. The old, wise veteran that has the future of the franchise to my side. It’s pretty cool to be a part of and we’re all going to be witnesses to what Cooper Flagg is going to do for a long time.”

Klay Thompson on Byron Scott, Cooper Flagg, Nov 30, 2025. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Byron Scott
item.description:
During his postgame comments, Klay Thompson referenced a video clip of Bryon Scott foreshadowing the greatness of the late Kobe Bryant.

“I’m not saying he’s going to be Kobe, but I remember this clip of Byron Scott looking in the camera talking about how great Kobe’s going to be when he was 18 years old.”

Klay Thompson on Byron Scott, Nov 30, 2025. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Olden Polynice on Byron Scott, Bill Laimbeer
item.description:
Olden Polynice:

“I broke Bill Laimbeer's face. I was the guy who broke his face. Byron Scott: That's why he was wearing that mask. Polynice: Let me tell you something: I ain't never received more cards and flowers in my life. Byron Scott: Everybody hated Laimbeer. The office called me and was like,”

Olden Polynice on Byron Scott, Bill Laimbeer, Jul 15, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: James Worthy on Byron Scott
item.description:
Scott also played for the Lakers.

“There was a story that went around, and he comes in at halftime one time and, like, f**k it! Byron Scott,”

James Worthy on Byron Scott, Aug 17, 2023. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Del Harris on Byron Scott, Jerome Kersey, Robert Horry
item.description:
Harris told The County Sun during shootaround.

“If it doesn’t work out, we’ll put Jerome Kersey in there. At this point, Jerome will be a backup, and we have to get him settled into that. And Byron Scott is a backup. Kobe knows when Robert’s back, he’ll go back (to coming off the bench).”

Del Harris on Byron Scott, Jerome Kersey, Robert Horry, Jan 28, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: James Worthy on Byron Scott
item.description:
On @TWCSportsNet,James Worthy on Byron Scott's firing:

“I thought maybe he would at least get until Feb to see if he can turn things around.”

James Worthy on Byron Scott, Apr 25, 2016. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: James Worthy on Byron Scott
item.description:
Mark Medina:James Worthy on if he didn't criticize Byron Scott enough:

“One thing we respect about each other is honesty. Byron didn't have anything to work with.”

James Worthy on Byron Scott, Apr 25, 2016. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Brandon Bass on Byron Scott, Mitch Kupchak
item.description:
Mark Medina:Brandon Bass:

“Mitch [Kupchak] and Coach Scott did a great job in putting the young guys out there.”

Brandon Bass on Byron Scott, Mitch Kupchak, Apr 14, 2016. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Julius Randle on Byron Scott
item.description:
Serena Winters:Julius Randle on Byron Scott’s teachings:

“We had to grow up. This year was rough for us all. We have to hold each other accountable.”

Julius Randle on Byron Scott, Apr 14, 2016. Source: Twitter @SerenaWinters.

item.title: Michael Malone on Byron Scott, D'Angelo Russell
item.description:
Nuggets'Michael Malone on D'Angelo Russell:

“Sometimes the bench is a good teacher. Byron Scott does a good job in doing what's best for D'Angelo & his team”

Michael Malone on Byron Scott, D'Angelo Russell, Mar 2, 2016. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: D'Angelo Russell on Byron Scott
item.description:
Lakers rookie point guard D'Angelo Russell said after Friday’s game.

“Coach [Byron Scott] was demanding we run it. It was kind of tough because we didn’t really get to run it against defense. We just talked about it, threw it in and then played with it. I feel like it’s a great offense, but it was kind of thrown at us.”

D'Angelo Russell on Byron Scott, Feb 27, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Byron Scott
item.description:
Rick Carlisle on Byron Scott :

“I greatly admire the job that Byron has done b/c he’s had to make tough choices. He's playing guys that have a chance to be in their future. It’s the right thing to do, but coaching a young team can be painful.”

Rick Carlisle on Byron Scott, Jan 26, 2016. Source: Twitter @SerenaWinters.

item.title: Jordan Hill on Byron Scott
item.description:
Mark Medina:Hill on Byron Scott criticizing post-game antics:

“He’s right about it. But we’re just trying to finish this out with our heads high.”

Jordan Hill on Byron Scott, Feb 25, 2015. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Byron Scott
item.description:
Mark Medina:Kobe on relationship w/ Byron Scott:

“I trust him implicitly. He taught me so much. I can talk to him about anything. I trust his judgment.”

Kobe Bryant on Byron Scott, Dec 29, 2014. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Kevin McHale on Byron Scott
item.description:
Jonathan Feigen:McHale on Byron Scott saying he'd put on the gold if McHale wears the green and white:

“Byron must feel a hell of a lot better than I do.”

Kevin McHale on Byron Scott, Oct 28, 2014. Source: Twitter @Jonathan_Feigen.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Byron Scott
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:Kobe on Byron Scott:

“He was my rookie mentor ... We've had a tremendously close relationship throughout the years”

Kobe Bryant on Byron Scott, Jul 9, 2014. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: James Worthy on Byron Scott, Nate McMillan, Mike Krzyzewski
item.description:
James Worthy:

“It’s funny, with so many players coming out of high school and one year of college, you're starting to see teams wanting college coaches and stuff like that, but right off the top of my head: I played with Byron Scott, so I know what he brings to the table. I know that he holds people accountable and he’s a defensive kind of genius when it comes to that. I like Nate McMillan. Nate McMillan spent some time with Coach K [Mike Krzyzewski] in USA/international basketball. I think he knows all the players that were on the team. He has a good rapport. But, I got to go with my good friend Byron Scott, if it was up to me.”

James Worthy on Byron Scott, Nate McMillan, Mike Krzyzewski, May 20, 2014. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Dan Gilbert on Byron Scott
item.description:
Dan Gilbert:

“We think Byron (Scott) has been great for this franchise. He brings stability to the team and franchise. He brings credibility. We love having Byron Scott as coach of the Cavaliers.”

Dan Gilbert on Byron Scott, May 9, 2012. Source: Sulia.
